data: Which of the following topics is present in both map extracts?

The question asks which topic is present in both map extracts. From the caption, we know that the focus is on the machine oil topic. In the 11x11 map extract, the machine oil topic is represented by a purple area, but it is described as being derived in a more fuzzy scope topic named 'machine and vehicles'. In the 16x16 map extract, the machine oil topic is also represented by a purple area, and it is more precisely defined compared to the 11x11 map. Therefore, the machine oil topic is present in both map extracts.
